title: AllOfNestedAnyOfUnevaluatedItems
description: Issue #135 asked whether unevaluatedItems has the same nesting gap, and it did. hasCousinUnevaluatedItems read the direct branches of the schema's own in-place applicators, so an anyOf one level down inside an allOf branch was invisible and the keyword fell back to static handling: [1,2] was accepted although the first branch leaves index 1 unevaluated and the second refuses a number. The identical anyOf written directly has always rejected it.
